notes.title: Update #2
notes.content:
[h1]Twitch Overhaul & Localization[/h1]

[h2]Twitch Overhaul[/h2]

I noticed from streamers and Steam reviews that my explanation of how the integration works seemed unclear or imprecise. Additionally, there was no real in-game indicator that anything was happening. I took this feedback into account and reworked the integration.

- I have now added a counter to the UI that shows, per room, how many reports viewers have submitted. This decreases if the player finds the anomaly associated with it.

- I wrote a shorter and more concise explanation.

- I redesigned the Twitch authentication, which now works with a confirmation in the browser. This looks more official and is easier. Additionally, there is now better feedback on whether it worked.

[h2]Localization[/h2]

I have now translated the entire game and achievements into various languages using AI. The system language is detected at the beginning, and if the language is available, it will automatically switch to it. If the language is not available, English will be chosen as a fallback. If that is also not desired, the language can be changed manually in the options.

notes.title: Update #1
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[h2]New Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Introduced UI elements for mouse navigation.
[/list]
[h2]Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a visual indicator for reports not found.
[*] The screen now closes automatically after a report is submitted.
[*] Increased the size of checkmarks on the report screen for better visibility.
[/list]
[h2]UI Enhancements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Eradicated two egregious and perilous misspellings that threatened the very fabric of our UI.
[/list]
[h1]Twitch Integration:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added handling for stream delay.
By default, streams have a delay, which is now accounted for and considered during gameplay.
[*] Streamers can now set a custom delay for their streams.
Additionally, some streamers prefer to use an extra stream delay, streaming live with a delay. Streamers can now incorporate this additional delay into the game as well.
[/list]

Added a visual indicator for reports not found.
The screen now closes automatically after a report is submitted.

notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.content:
[h2]UI:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed: The progress bar at the top of the screen can be dragged
[*] Fixed: Losing a game with a report time of, for example, 6 seconds, and starting a new game will show the correct report time now.
[*] Fixed: If a game is lost while a report is still pending, the time bar would freeze in a new game, preventing further reports.

[*] Added: Pressing ESC while in the report screen now closes the report screen instead of taking you to the main menu. A second press of ESC will take you to the game menu.
[/list]

[h2]Menu:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed: selecting a chapter would show [Q] PREVIOUS TAB at the bottom. It is now deleted
[*] Adjusted: Menu sounds are now balanced and no longer excessively loud compared to in-game sounds.
[/list]

[h2]Art Gallery:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed: "Exibition" is now "Exhibition."
[/list]

[h2]Black Lab:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed: In the Surgery room, on a specific anomaly the shadows were moving.
[/list]

[h2]Country House:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added: A crackling cosy fire sound effect in the Living Room.
[/list]

[h2]Added Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added: Modal window to confirm exiting the game before actually exiting.
[/list]
